==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈpɒz.ɪ.t(ə.)ɹɪ/|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈpɑ.zɪˌtɔɹ.i/|a=US,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-repository.ogg|a=California}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|reposytorye}}, from {{der|en|la|repositōrium}}.<ref>{{R:OED Online|pos=n|id=2964548479}}</ref> {{surf|en|reposit|-ory<id:nominal>}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# A location for [[storage]], often for safety or [[preservation]].
#: {{syn|en|''See'' [[storehouse]]}}
## {{lb|en|[[archiving]]|computing}} A storage location for [[file]]s, such as [[downloadable]] [[software]] [[package]]s, or files in a [[source control]] system.
##: {{syn|en|archive#Noun}}
##: {{hypo|en|content repository|e-repository|data warehouse}}
## A burial [[vault]].
##: {{hypo|en|deep geological repository}}
## {{lb|en|figurative}} A person to whom a [[secret]] is [[entrusted]].
## {{lb|en|dated}} A place where things are [[store]]d for [[sale]]; a [[shop]].
